son of Mr. Vikram &
Mrs. Neha Malhotra

daughter of Mr. Arjun &

Sunday · 7 March 2027 · Bengaluru

Our story

How it happened

202120232026

One rainy evening

A café, two cappuccinos and a conversation that lasted till closing time. Neither of us noticed the rain had stopped.

Misty hills, open windows

Our first road trip. Wrong turns, roadside chai, and her hand catching the wind all the way up.

A rooftop at sunset

Candles, a little velvet box and one question. She said yes before he could finish asking.

Join us

for the ring ceremony

images.alt: Rohan slipping the solitaire ring onto Ishita's finger, candles and roses behind
Two cappuccinos with heart latte art, their hands touching on a marble café table by a rainy window
Ishita's hand catching the wind from the car window on a misty hill road at sunrise, Rohan driving
